intended_object: The map on the space of right cosets H\G of a subgroup H given by right multiplication by a fixed a ∈ G, Hx ↦ Hxa. This comes from the docstring and the module documentation, which describe the right action of G on right cosets.
explanation:
`RightCosetQuotient H` is `Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)`. Under this relation x ~ y exactly when y·x⁻¹ ∈ H, that is, when Hx = Hy, so the quotient is the space of right cosets H\G. The definition lifts x ↦ [x·a]. The well-definedness proof checks that (y·a)(x·a)⁻¹ = y·x⁻¹ ∈ H. So the map is exactly Hx ↦ Hxa, the standard right action of G on right cosets. It works for any group G and any subgroup H; normality is not needed and not assumed, so the generality is natural.

I found no Mathlib definition of this map. Mathlib has `QuotientGroup.rightRel` and the bijection `quotientRightRelEquivQuotientLeftRel`. It also has the left action of G on G ⧸ H through `MulAction.quotient`. I found nothing defining the right-multiplication action on `Quotient (rightRel H)`. Writing it out here is therefore not a narrower restatement of an existing general construction.
